prompt: ISO 26262: what are the technical requirements for the functional requirement "HMI shall need less than 50 ms to send a signal to Speaker/Driver Display after receiving the signal from Ethernet Interface"?
response: For the functional requirement "HMI shall need less than 50 ms to send a signal to Speaker/Driver Display after receiving the signal from Ethernet Interface," the technical requirements could include: 1) The HMI software must be optimized to process signals within 40 ms to account for potential network latency. 2) The Ethernet interface must support a minimum data rate to ensure timely signal transmission. 3) The Speaker/Driver Display must be capable of receiving and processing signals within 10 ms. These requirements ensure the system meets the response time criteria.
